ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels relative to 10% high-intensity (white/beige) pixels representing scars and barnacles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity background with high-contrast white linear streaks (scars) distributed semi-randomly; dense clusters of high-intensity pixels are localized at the distal fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 35-degree interior angle forming a narrow U-shaped depression at the central midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire margin; right lobe (image right) exhibits higher-amplitude peaks and valleys (jagged) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature from the central notch toward the lateral tips on both fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively at the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) varying in length and orientation across the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips and dense network of rake-mark scarring across the ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion along the central-lower boundary caused by high-intensity water spray and droplets.
